description: Two-wheeler rider/pillion not wearing ISI-marked helmet
first_offense_note: Disqualification of licence for 3 months possible
process: Officer must show official challan, provide receipt. You have the right to ask for their badge number.

description: Driver or front-seat passenger not wearing seat belt
first_offense_note: Applies to driver and all passengers
process: Officer must issue official challan. On-the-spot cash payment without receipt is NOT legal.

description: Using handheld mobile phone while operating a vehicle
first_offense_note: Includes talking, texting, or any use of handheld device
process: Hands-free calling with Bluetooth is permitted. If stopped, you can request clarification of the specific violation.

description: Blood alcohol content above permissible limit (30mg/100ml blood)
first_offense_note: Imprisonment up to 6 months OR fine OR both. Repeat offense: imprisonment up to 2 years.
process: Officer has right to conduct breathalyzer test. You can request a blood test at a government hospital if you dispute the reading.

description: Crossing red traffic light without stopping
first_offense_note: May result in licence suspension
process: If caught by camera, e-challan will be sent to registered address. If stopped by officer, demand official challan.

description: Exceeding speed limit in a light motor vehicle
first_offense_note: Speed limit varies by zone: 50 km/h city, 80 km/h highway, 100 km/h expressway
process: Officer must show radar speed reading if using a speed gun. E-challan notice contains speed camera evidence.

description: Exceeding speed limit in a bus, truck, or medium vehicle
first_offense_note: Stricter limits apply: 40 km/h city, 60 km/h highway
process: If you believe the speed was wrongly measured, you can contest through the e-challan portal or in court.

description: Operating a vehicle without a valid driving licence
first_offense_note: Licence may be suspended for 3 months
process: DigiLocker / mParivahan digital licence is legally valid. Officer cannot demand physical licence if digital is shown.

description: Vehicle not registered or registration expired
first_offense_note: Repeat offense may lead to vehicle being impounded
process: RC on DigiLocker is legally valid. Ensure your RC renewal is done within 15 years (after which vehicle must be re-registered).

description: Driving vehicle without valid third-party insurance
first_offense_note: Vehicle may be seized. Community service also possible.
process: Digital insurance certificate on DigiLocker or insurer app is valid proof. Keep your policy number handy.

description: Parking in a no-parking zone, red line, or bus stop
law_reference: Section 177, Motor Vehicles Act / BBMP Bye-laws
first_offense_note: Vehicle may be towed; additional towing charges apply
process: If vehicle is towed, you are entitled to a receipt for towing and must be informed of the impound location. Towing without proper notice is contestable.

description: Performing stunts, reckless driving endangering public safety
first_offense_note: Imprisonment up to 6 months possible
process: Video evidence required by officer. You can request to see the evidence if no dashcam or camera is mentioned.

description: Driving a vehicle without valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate
first_offense_note: Imprisonment up to 6 months also possible
process: PUC certificate available digitally. Always keep your PUC updated — valid for 6 months for BS6 vehicles.

description: Carrying more passengers than the vehicle's capacity
first_offense_note: Plus ₹1000 per extra passenger
process: Seating capacity is listed on the RC. Officer can check registered seating capacity.

violation_name: Use of Prohibited Horn / Pressure Horn
description: Using pressure horns, multi-tone horns, or horns in hospital/school zones
law_reference: Section 190(2), Motor Vehicles Act / CMVR Rule 119
first_offense_note: Horn must meet approved standards; no horns near hospitals, schools, courts
process: If officer claims your regular horn is prohibited, ask them to specify the rule. Musical horns are prohibited.

description: Windshield or side windows with film below prescribed Visual Light Transmission (VLT)
law_reference: Section 177, Motor Vehicles Act / CMVR Rule 100
first_offense_note: VLT must be 70% for front windshield, 50% for side windows
process: Factory-fitted tints meeting VLT norms are legal. After-market film is not permitted. Request challan for film confiscation.

description: Driving on the wrong side of the road or not following lane discipline
first_offense_note: Licence suspension for repeat offense
process: If emergency was the reason (ambulance bypass, etc.), you can explain with evidence. Otherwise, accept challan and pay through official portal.

description: Using fancy, unauthorized, or non-HSRP number plate
law_reference: Section 192, Motor Vehicles Act / CMVR Rule 50
first_offense_note: HSRP (High Security Registration Plate) mandatory for new vehicles
process: Fancy fonts, colored plates, and non-standard sizes are all violations. Get HSRP from RTO-authorized vendors only.

description: Exceeding 25 km/h speed limit in designated school or hospital zones
first_offense_note: School zones active 7AM-9AM and 3PM-5PM on school days
process: Speed cameras are active in most school zones. E-challan sent to registered address.

violation_name: Not Giving Way to Emergency Vehicle
description: Failing to give way to ambulance, fire brigade, or police vehicles with sirens
first_offense_note: Imprisonment up to 6 months also possible
process: Always pull to the left and stop when you hear emergency sirens. The route should be kept clear.

violation_name: Not Yielding to Pedestrian at Zebra Crossing
description: Failing to stop for pedestrians at a marked zebra crossing
law_reference: Section 177, Motor Vehicles Act / Rule 9 CMVR
first_offense_note: Always give priority to pedestrians at unmarked/marked crossings
process: Increasingly enforced via cameras at intersections. Drivers must slow down and stop when pedestrians are crossing.

description: Carrying goods exceeding the registered payload capacity
first_offense_note: Plus ₹2,000 per metric ton of excess load
process: Weigh bridge receipts serve as evidence. Registered payload is listed on the RC/permit.

violation_name: Improper Use of High Beam / Dazzling Headlights
description: Using high-beam headlights in city areas or against oncoming traffic
first_offense_note: High beam should only be used on unlit highways with no oncoming vehicles
process: Dip headlights at least 200m before meeting oncoming vehicle. In city limits, high beam is discouraged.

description: Operating a vehicle that has never been registered with the RTO
first_offense_note: Vehicle may be seized. Dealerships must not allow unregistered test drives on public roads.
process: From the date of purchase, vehicle must be registered within 30 days. Temporary registration certificate (TRC) valid for 30 days.

description: Person below 18 years of age driving a motor vehicle
first_offense_note: Guardian liable. Vehicle registration may be cancelled for 1 year. Minor cannot obtain licence until age 25.
process: Guardian of the minor faces criminal liability. The minor cannot apply for licence until 25 under the new law.
